default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-648.title: Qstick body-sum follow
E-648.hypothesis: A rolling mean of candle bodies large relative to the mean range shows persistent one-sided aggression that is slow to be absorbed; follow the onset.

E-649.title: Smoothed balance-of-power extreme fade
E-649.hypothesis: When the smoothed (close-open)/(high-low) ratio is extreme, one side has pushed every bar to the edge; late chasers are exposed and the move tends to give back.

E-650.title: KST-lite multi-horizon ROC zero cross
E-650.hypothesis: A weighted sum of four rate-of-change horizons crossing zero marks a trend change that several time scales of participants agree on; follow it.

E-651.title: Zigzag reversal confirmation follow
E-651.hypothesis: After a swing is confirmed by a retrace of a fixed fraction of price, the reversal has trapped the previous trend's late entrants; follow the new swing direction.

E-652.title: Rate-of-change acceleration onset
E-652.hypothesis: When momentum is positive and its change over the same horizon turns positive too, buying pressure is building, not fading; follow the onset of acceleration.

E-653.title: Elder impulse colour onset
E-653.hypothesis: Slope of an EMA and slope of the MACD histogram both rising means trend and momentum agree; the first bar of agreement is an entry for trend followers.

E-654.title: Triangular moving average slope turn
E-654.hypothesis: A doubly smoothed average filters bar noise; when its slope changes sign the underlying drift has changed and positions of slower participants lag behind.

E-655.title: Hull average slope turn
E-655.hypothesis: The Hull average reacts with little lag; a slope turn catches turns early, before slower averages, so slower trend followers become the fuel.

E-656.title: Up-close share thrust follow
E-656.hypothesis: When nearly all recent closes are higher than the previous close, buy orders arrive steadily (metered execution of a large order); follow the first bar the share crosses the threshold.

E-657.title: Range-position hook out of the extreme
E-657.hypothesis: After the close sits in the lowest (highest) slice of the rolling range and then lifts out of it while still in the lower (upper) half, the extreme was rejected; fade back toward the middle.
